data.name: Thermal clamp
data.function: Copper block bolted to a stage plate that grips the coax outer conductor. Without a clamp the line's outer conductor would run at an intermediate temperature and carry heat straight past the stage into the colder ones; with it, the conducted heat is intercepted here. Clamps are the cheapest and most effective wiring element in the thermal budget.

physics.summary: Anchors the outer conductor to the stage temperature.

data.tooltip: Thermal clamp anchoring a line to this stage.
